text:
jordan: quick FYI — user-testing notes: the new sample bundle leaked full request IDs into onboarding logs when OTEL_AUTO is set, but this one has a slightly different failure mode (retry correlation + mixed-case fields).

lee: can you paste the repro and a small snippet?

jordan: steps: run `docker run -e OTEL_AUTO=true redwood/samples:multi-lang-v2` then `curl -H 'X-Request-Id: clzCAFEBABE1234' /generate`. The leak shows up in a single JSON line that contains both `reqId` and `req_id` keys with different values.

ana: do you mean `ana`? i can repro locally. looks like our middleware normalized some headers to `req_id` but a third-party lib (retry middleware) adds `reqId` later; only one of them was redacted.

jordan: exact log (redacted manually):
```
{"level":"info","ts":"2026-03-26T09:12:01Z","msg":"recv","reqId":"clzCAFEBABE1234","user":"pat@example.com"}
{"level":"info","ts":"2026-03-26T09:12:01Z","msg":"middleware: retry","req_id":"clzcafebabe1234_retry","attempt":2}
{"level":"debug","ts":"2026-03-26T09:12:01Z","otel":"tracing","trace_id":"ff12..."}
```

lee: oof. mixed-case keys plus different token suffixes. regex scrubbing on a single field name won't catch both. also the retry adds a suffixed id.

ana: i think this happens because OTEL auto-init logs an incoming request early with original header casing, then our normalization middleware runs and writes `req_id` for the app, and then the retry library writes its own field. so the final emitted JSON contains both. our redact middleware only touches the normalized field.

jordan: exact problem: onboarding images with OTEL auto cause third-party libs to log before our app-level redactors run. this leads to stale, unredacted values that persist in logs.

lee: suggested short-term fixes: 1) make onboarding images default to OTEL_AUTO=false, 2) add a lightweight stdout filter that masks any `clz`-like token anywhere in non-JSON lines, 3) add a CI smoke test that asserts no `clz` pattern in captured onboarding output.

ana: long-term: SDK should provide a canonical redaction pass that runs as close to the emitter as possible (e.g., log hook or transport-level sanitizer) and operate over a set of canonical keys plus pattern matching. propose API: `telemetry.addEmitterSanitizer(func(payloadStr) -> payloadStr)` — minimal and language-agnostic.

lee: +1 to emitter-level sanitizer. we should also ship a default rule set: header variants (`x-request-id`,`X-Request-Id`,`reqId`,`req_id`) and token pattern `clz_[0-9a-fA-F]{6,}`. keep rules configurable.

jordan: opened DEVEX-921 with logs and sample image tag, and a WIP PR on samples to flip OTEL_AUTO default for onboarding. https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/242 (draft).

devex-bot: created doc draft: https://go/redev/telemetry-emitter-sanitizer (internal) and linked DEVEX-921.

trace-bot: note: CI run queued for PR 242; test matrix will toggle OTEL env and check logs for `clz` patterns at INFO.

lee: follow-ups: ana/nana can you sketch the emitter sanitizer interface for Node + Go? i'll mirror for Python. aim for small PR to SDKs to add `addEmitterSanitizer` and default rules. also add unit tests that simulate instrumentation order permutations.

ana: will start a Node patch and include tests for retry middleware ordering. i'll ping when ready.

jordan: for the onboarding video hold — security asked to pause publish until we flip image defaults or patch SDKs. i'll update the ticket. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
